fields.error_behavior: Never invent an unknown species or persist an unconfirmed Low result.

fields.fallback: Use IMAGE_QUALITY_GENERIC_FROZEN verbatim; never diagnose unmeasured blur, light or angle.
fields.error_behavior: Unregistered reasons are not shown/invented; Technical Failure remains separate.

coverage.empty: Optional metadata/story may remain empty; Medium/Low species confirmation gates persistence; missing photo or quality state is not fabricated.
coverage.loading: Result is entered only after real model resolution; save loading preserves layout/drafts and prevents duplicate submission.
coverage.error: No Fish/Image Quality create no record; save errors stay retryable; Technical Failure is separate.
coverage.partial: Optional user fields stay empty; Model M1, Quality Gate, Device, GPS and Capture Asset sources remain traceable through the lineage registry.
coverage.network_failure: Reported persistence/network failure stays retryable with fields/destination preserved; it is never relabeled as Image Quality.

lineage_boundary: Every Result field follows UI → Data Contract → Source Owner via design/system_v3/08_Page_Contracts/recognition/result/Recognition_Result_Data_Lineage_V1.json. This closes page-level source mapping only; no Android repository, Backend/API, database or local-store schema is changed or claimed.
